title.zh: 查询 SQL 文本信息

descriptions.zh: 为优化用户体验，云数据库对 SQL 诊断功能进行了升级，本接口已下线并由新的接口替代，详情请参见 <props="china">[【通知】云数据库诊断管理 API 接口下线](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2352272.html?spm=a2c4g.292641.0.0.8d3622f8LtqWiM)</props><props="intl">[【通知】云数据库诊断管理 API 接口下线](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaradb-for-oceanbase/latest/notice-cloud-database-diagnosis-management-api-interface-downline)</props>。
descriptions.en: To optimize User Experience, ApsaraDB has upgraded the SQL Diagnosis feature. This API has been unpublished and overridden by a new API. For details, see <props="china">[【Notice】ApsaraDB Diagnosis Management API Interface Unpublished](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2352272.html?spm=a2c4g.292641.0.0.8d3622f8LtqWiM)</props><props="intl">[【Notice】ApsaraDB Diagnosis Management API Interface Unpublished](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/apsaradb-for-oceanbase/latest/notice-cloud-database-diagnosis-management-api-interface-downline)</props>.
